covered: Reviewed commit cf5650b ("M6: the phone, the seven Keepsakes, seven synergies"): my worktree was cut from `main`, which holds only docs, so I detached it there; the shared checkout's uncommitted Adaptation edits (wheel_sim.gd, encounter_sim.gd) were not reviewed, and all line numbers below are as of cf5650b. I read GDD 7.5 and the seven built rows of 7.8 against item_sim.gd, the hooks in drive_sim.gd (capture/restore, _retell, _set_stretch/begin_leg/begin_act, _apply_collisions, _apply_statuses), stop_sim.gd, the data and the three test suites, then drove the seams with probes (all in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/wf2/, run as `godot --headless --path . --script <probe> -- <function names>`), six mutants (four survived) and a fuzz of 30 random Tellings (136 stops, 58 Wrecks: no script error, no broken invariant). What held: every row of 7.5 and 7.8 does what the GDD and D-042 say on the road; the charm's spent scrape, the tape's spent flag, leg-held statuses, call counters, supply and heat pass through leg stops; a save taken at each of the 12 stops of a Telling (all three acts, leg and boss stops) loaded from its text matches the uninterrupted simulation to the state hash, also 3 s later; a mend in progress is finished on entering either kind of stop; a Wreck resets all item state.

findings.title: Pulled over, the Clock stands but the phone keeps ringing: unlimited cash (and calm) while the officer waits
findings.evidence: probe_pullover.gd (Patrol leg, Act 2, phone + taxi sign + beads, fourth gear once the police watch): pulled over at t=26.7 s; then 40 calls answered during 663 s of waiting: cash +710, clock.minutes +0.0, leg.time +0.0, still pulled over, Nerves 34. probe_pullover2.gd: phone alone, 18 calls in 600 s: +140 cash, Clock +0 (the bribe to drive on is 60 and 5 min); a tape alone calms at its -1/s with the Clock at +0; for contrast 60 s braked to rest on the shoulder cost 20 Clock minutes. Cause: step 9 (effects.step, items.step, _feed_nerves, nerves.step) is gated on `not stopped` (line 388), while the car, collisions, the leg's and the encounter's clocks and the Clock (line 404) are gated on `not _standing()` (pulled_over or stopped). _step_suspicion returns while pulled_over, so even a Snap there costs nothing.
findings.failure_scenario: Any Patrol leg (Acts 2-3; every act at the Uncles' Table) with a phone on the mount: hold fourth gear about 7 s until Suspicion is 100, then stay at the officer and answer every call. Each dispatcher call pays 10 (15 with the taxi sign, +20 every third); the Clock, the leg's par clock and Suspicion do not move and nothing can hit him, for as long as the player likes. Then hand over the banknotes (60 in Act 2, 5 minutes). Beads, the radio or a tape likewise bring Nerves anywhere for no time.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 12.1 'Phone, if owned: 10 per answered call ... typical 25 [a leg]' and 12 'A competent Telling earns 350 to 600 cash'; 6.4 (the Clock is the price of standing still); 2.2 pillar 3 'Everything that helps also costs'. DECISIONS D-031: 'Nothing moves on while the officer waits: the leg's clock and the encounter stop, the car does not move, nothing can hit him' - items, statuses and Nerves do move on.
findings.suggested_fix: Gate step 9 on `not _standing()` as the Clock is (nothing burns, rings or calms while the officer waits), or keep it running and let the Clock run with it.

findings.title: After a Wreck the save still holds the Telling that wrecked: continuing undoes the Wreck
findings.evidence: probe_wreck_save.gd drives the real scenes/drive.tscn: at the first stop save.json holds stage=stop, seed=1, retellings=0, 22:10; he leaves, five scrapes, Wreck, told again (seed 1329599597722160173, retellings 1, 22:00); two seconds into the new Telling save.json still holds stage=stop, seed=1, retellings=0, and Game.read_save() + DriveSim.restore() (what --continue does, drive_controller.gd:62) returns true: he stands at that fuel station with 0 lamps at 22:10. The controller writes only on `stop_entered` (line 120) and clears only on `arrived` (line 124); DriveSim._retell() (drive_sim.gd:719) leaves `checkpoint` as it was (probe_seams1.gd wreck_checkpoint: not empty, seed 1, retellings 0, restores with the beads he had). This is M5 code, seen through the Wreck seam.
findings.failure_scenario: He wrecks on the second leg of Act 2 with a full cabin. The player quits before the retold Telling reaches its first stop and continues: the wrecked Telling is back at its last stop with its items, cash and the lamps it had there. Repeatable after every Wreck, at every Table.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 3.2 'On a Wreck ... the Telling restarts from Baghdad within 3 s'; 11.4 Wreck: 'the Telling restarts in 3 s'; 11.2 The Children: 'One free rewind: the first Wreck returns to the start of that leg' (a rule only if the other Tables have none); 2.1 'Carried between Tellings: ... Never power.'
findings.suggested_fix: When the Telling is told again, clear DriveSim.checkpoint in _retell() and have the controller write a save with no Telling on `wreck`, as it does on `arrived`.

findings.title: The photo's once-per-leg and the charm's first scrape are renewed by the boss stop and by the 170 m approach: the photo calms four times in a row around every boss
findings.evidence: probe_seams1.gd photo (Nerves set to 95 before each look, by hand at the visor): in the boss 95 -> 75 (a second look: nothing); at the boss stop photo_used=false and 95 -> 75 with the Clock unchanged; on the approach of Act 2 (s=0.5 of 170 m) 95 -> 75; 0.4 m past the gore 95 -> 75. probe_flask_photo.gd: with the flask each look after a sip is -45: 99 -> 54 in the boss, 54 -> 9 at the boss stop, 9 -> 0 on the approach. probe_seams2.gd charm_approach: the first scrape on the approach is spared, and so is one 12 m into the leg. probe_acts.gd: at every boss stop leg_state reads {photo:false, spared:false, held:[]} though it was true before the stop. Cause: _set_stretch() calls items.begin_leg() for every stretch (line 461: _enter_approach, _begin_boss, restore), and restore()'s boss branch (lines 845-851) never calls items.set_leg_state() although capture() saves leg_state at boss stops too.
findings.failure_scenario: Nerves 95 at the end of the Checkpoint: look at the photo in the boss's last metres, again while parked at the boss stop, again while rolling to the fork, again past the gore: 95 -> 15 in under half a minute of play, with no hand cost for the look at the stop. The charm likewise gives a free scrape on each approach on top of the one in the leg behind it.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 4.6 and 6.1: 'Visor photo: -20, once per leg'; 7.5 'The first scrape each leg lights no lamp'; 1.6 'An act is 3 legs and a boss' (the approach is neither). D-041: the save holds 'whether the photo has been looked at this leg, which until now a stop forgot' - a boss stop still forgets it. (D-041 also reads 'for the leg' as 'until the next stretch of road begins'; whether the approach is a leg of its own for once-per-leg things is the part that rests on reading.)
findings.suggested_fix: Put leg_state back at a boss stop as at a leg's stop, and do not begin a new leg for the items at the approach (reset there or at the first gore, not at both).

findings.title: A stop cancels the craving: a cigarette that is burning, or burnt out less than 30 s ago, when he stops never costs its +8
findings.evidence: probe_seams1.gd craving. No stop: 30 s after burn-out Nerves step 12.34 -> 20.34 (+8). Lit, then into the stall: at the stop lit=false, burning=false, lapse_left=-1.0, and in the 75 s after leaving no step of more than 5 Nerves. Burnt out and 20 s into the 30 (lapse_left=8.83), then into the stall: at the stop lapse_left=-1.0, and no step afterwards. Cause: capture() saves id, slot, supply and heat of an item (line 746) and _build() makes the Item anew; `burning` and `lapse_left` (item_sim.gd:1199-1203, 1207) are in no save and not in leg_state.
findings.failure_scenario: He lights one cigarette on each leg within about 55 s of the stall (the second half of a par leg) and pulls in: full 25 s burn, -10 Nerves, and the craving never comes, on every leg of the Telling. A chain-smoker's last cigarette before each stop is free of it too.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 7.4 Cigarettes, Takes: 'Craving: +8 Nerves once if another is not lit within 30 s.' D-038 lists what a stop ends ('every timed effect ends, the haze is gone ... items keep their supply and a drink its heat'); the craving is not a status but the cigarette's upkeep, and is not in that list. D-025: 'The craving timer starts when a cigarette burns out'.
findings.suggested_fix: Carry the craving through the stop: save the seconds left with the item (and arm it when the stop puts a burning cigarette out), as leg_state carries the photo.

findings.title: T-ITEM-DUCT-TAPE passes when the tape renews with every leg, and when a boss stop forgets the mend
findings.evidence: Mutant 1: `tape_spent = false` added to ItemSim.begin_leg() (item_sim.gd:331), so the tape takes the first fault of every leg: T-ITEM-DUCT-TAPE, T-ITEM-CHARM, T-SAVE-01 and T-RUN-02 all PASS. The test's 'second fault of the act' (lines 212-216 and 226-232) is always lit on the same leg as the first, before or after that leg's stop. Mutant 2: `items.finish_mending()` removed from _end_boss() (drive_sim.gd:701): T-ITEM-DUCT-TAPE, T-SAVE-01, T-RUN-01, T-RUN-02 PASS; with it a fault lit in the last 10 s of a boss is never mended (the rebuild at the boss stop drops `mending`, tape_spent stays true). Only the leg's stop is tested (lines 250-257).
findings.failure_scenario: A regression that gives nine self-repairs a Telling instead of three, or one that leaves the boss's last fault lit for good with the tape spent, ships with the test green.
findings.gdd_reference: tests.json T-ITEM-DUCT-TAPE: 'Duct tape (7.5): the first fault each act repairs itself after 10 s'; D-042: 'that fault mends itself 10 s later, or the moment he stands at a stop'.
findings.suggested_fix: After the first mend drive into the next leg of the same act (_into_next_quiet_leg) and check that a fault lit there stays; repeat the 'reaching a stop before the 10 s are up' check at a boss stop.

findings.title: Nothing tests that the call count, the answered row or the photo pass through a stop (two mutants survive)
findings.evidence: Mutant A: ItemSim.set_telling_state() (item_sim.gd:359) puts back calls and answered_run as 0: T-ITEM-PHONE, T-ITEM-TAXI-SIGN, T-SYN-PHONE-TAXI-SIGN, T-SAVE-01, T-STOP-01, T-RUN-01, T-RUN-02, T-REPLAY-01 all PASS. Mutant B: set_leg_state() (item_sim.gd:365) puts back photo as false: all 27 implemented T-ITEM/T-SYN tests and T-SAVE-01 PASS. No phone test, no synergy test and no photo check (tests/test_item_base.gd:342, tests/test_synergies.gd:151 and 265) crosses a stop; T-SAVE-01 compares two simulations that both went through restore().
findings.failure_scenario: With A the count starts again at every stop: between two stops there are two or three calls, so the fourth call never comes and Um Noor never rings, and three answered in a row can only happen inside one leg. With B the photo calms twice a leg, before and after its stop. Both are what D-041 and D-042 say must not happen.
findings.gdd_reference: tests.json T-ITEM-PHONE 'one call in four is Um Noor: -8 Nerves'; T-SYN-PHONE-TAXI-SIGN 'three calls answered in a row pay a 20 cash bonus'; T-ITEM-BASE 'visor photo (-20 once per leg ...)'. D-042: 'The count of calls and of calls answered in a row pass through a stop'; D-041: the save holds 'whether the photo has been looked at this leg'.
findings.suggested_fix: In T-ITEM-PHONE and T-SYN-PHONE-TAXI-SIGN answer calls on both sides of _into_stall()/_leave_stop() and check the fourth is hers and the third in a row pays; in the photo check look once, pass the leg's stop and look again.

findings.title: At a stop every Habit is free and no timer runs: beads give unlimited calm for nothing, and cigarette, Courage, tea and seeds are loaded at the stall to start when he drives off
findings.evidence: probe_seams1.gd beads_at_stop: at a Hitcher stop (2 minutes) 30 beads in 11 s take Nerves 90 -> 30 with the Clock at +0.0. probe_seams3.gd stop_preload: 35 s at a stop: a cigarette lit, three sips of arak, a sip of tea, a handful of seeds; 30 s later still lit left=35.0 (25 + the tea's 10), courage=3 with 45.0 left, awake 40.0, chewing 20.0; Nerves 60 -> 33; Clock +0.0; on the road they start from full. Cause: at a stop _begin_at() offers the cabin's rituals as on the road (lines 1512-1514) while effects and items do not step (line 388).
findings.failure_scenario: With beads (30 cash) every stop, even the 2-minute Hitcher, sets Nerves to anything below what he came with, so the tea stall's 20 minutes buy no calm. The 1.6 s off the wheel for a cigarette, the three sips for three Courage stacks and the pill's blocked view cost nothing done at the stall, and their full time is delivered on the road.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 2.2 pillar 1 'Every action competes for the same hand. No action is free.'; pillar 3 'Habits take the hand'; 12.4 rule 3 'Nothing is a free stat'; 7.4 Worry beads, Takes: 'Only the hand. Calm leads to Heavy.'; 9.6 'A stop offers one service ... Tea stall: Sets Nerves to 30 ... 20'. This follows from D-036 ('At a stop the night waits: ... effect timers, items and Nerves do not step; the hand, gestures and rituals do'), taken in M5 before any Habit could be bought; I quote both because the two no longer fit together.
findings.suggested_fix: Owner's call: at a stop offer only the tray, the wheel and what the stop needs, or let what he uses there run down there.

findings.title: A Snap at a stop never ends: he cannot reach the tray until he drives off
findings.evidence: probe_seams2.gd snap_at_stop: he comes to a fuel station at Nerves 93 and drinks an energy drink there (+10): Snap, Nerves 70, snap_left=2.0, hand.can_reach=false. 10 s later and 70 s later at the stop snap_left is still 2.0 and the snapshot's `snap` is true; the hand does not reach an offer (reach fails, cash unchanged). 2.5 s after he leaves, snap_left=0.0. Cause: hand.can_reach follows nerves.snap_left (line 326), which only NervesSim.step() counts down, and that is not called while stopped (line 388).
findings.failure_scenario: Frayed at 90 or more he drinks the can (or slaps himself) before shopping: for the rest of the stop he can buy, restock and repair nothing; only gripping the wheel and leaving works, and the stop cannot be come back to.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 6.1 'Snap: he leans on the horn for 2 s. He can steer and cannot reach.' GDD 17.2 'No time limit at stops'.
findings.suggested_fix: Count the Snap's two seconds down at a stop too: they are the hand's time, not the night's.

findings.title: What a stop ends is never announced: the tape's mend, a ringing call, statuses (low severity, no listener yet)
findings.evidence: probe_seams1.gd mend_event: duct tape holding a fault, into the stall: lamps 1 -> 0 and 0 `fault_repaired` events (the same mend on the road announces 1). probe_seams2.gd ringing_at_stop: `call_started`, then the stop: caller is '' and there is no `call_resolved`. probe_seams3.gd expired_at_stop: `lit` ends at the stop with no `effect_expired`. Cause: items.finish_mending() (line 617, and 701) queues its event in the ItemSim that _save_point() -> restore() -> _build() replaces before any tick drains items.events; the rebuild itself announces nothing.
findings.failure_scenario: Anything that pairs these signals (a ring loop started on call_started, a lamp-out sound on fault_repaired, a burning cigarette drawn from effect_added/effect_expired) is left hanging at every stop.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 13.6 lists `fault_repaired`, `call_resolved`, `effect_expired` on the Events bus; 16.3 (lamps and supplies are read from what the cabin shows).
findings.suggested_fix: In _save_point(), announce what is waiting in items.events before _build(), and announce the end of a ringing call and of each status the stop ends.

findings.title: The wait for the next call starts again at every stop
findings.evidence: probe_next_call.gd (four seeds): a call answered, 20 s driven, the leg's stop, on: road time from the end of that call to the next ring is 49.82, 49.56, 60.6 and 50.44 s. `_call_wait` is in no save; after the rebuild it is drawn afresh (25 to 40 s) on the first tick after he leaves.
findings.failure_scenario: With a stop on every leg the third call of a leg (due about 100 s after the last stop) never comes before the next stall: two calls a leg where the GDD's 'typical 25' cash means two and a half, and the three-in-a-row bonus comes correspondingly later.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 7.4 Phone: 'A call every 25 to 40 s'; 12.1 'Phone, if owned ... typical 25'. D-042: 'The wait for the next call ... is counted from the end of the last one'. (D-038/D-040 say every timer ends at a stop, so this may be meant; reported because the task names it and the gap is measurable.)
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the seconds left of the wait in item_state.

findings.title: Hung up mid-leg or mid-act, the charm and the tape treat the next scrape or fault as the first
findings.evidence: probe_seams3.gd acquired_late: a leg with one scrape (lamp lit), the charm put in the cabin at that leg's stop, a second scrape in the leg's last 170 m: spared=true. An act with two faults lit, the tape put in at the stop, a third fault: lamps 3, and 2 after 10.5 s. scrape_spared and tape_spent are set only by a scrape or fault the keepsake itself took (absorbs_scrape line 1065, on_faults_lit line 1074).
findings.failure_scenario: Bought at a stop, the charm spares the leg's second scrape and the tape mends the act's third fault: one lamp less than the row allows, once per purchase.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 7.5 'The first scrape each leg lights no lamp'; 'The first fault each act repairs itself after 10 s'.
findings.suggested_fix: Mark the leg's first scrape and the act's first fault whether or not the keepsake is aboard.

findings.title: The cigarette's calm runs one tick long: -10.0033 over the burn
findings.evidence: probe_drip.gd: lit and ashed at Nerves 80, nothing else acting: Nerves fall on 3,001 ticks, 10.00333 in all, while `lit` is on for 3,000. The drip ends on `drip.y <= 0.0` after 3,000 subtractions of 1/120 from 25.0, which leave a positive remainder. T-ITEM-CIGARETTES allows 0.01.
findings.failure_scenario: Every cigarette calms by 10.0033 instead of 10; harmless in play, but it is the one countdown in ItemSim/EffectSystem that is not counted in whole ticks.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 7.4 '-10 Nerves over the burn'; D-040 'Timed statuses are counted in whole ticks like every other countdown ... a 25 s status is on for exactly 3,000 ticks'.
findings.suggested_fix: End a drip when less than half a tick of it is left (`drip.y < dt * 0.5`), as EffectSystem.step() does.

covered: Every row of GDD 7.4 (cigarettes to arak flask) was traced through data/items.json, data/rituals.json, item_sim.gd, drive_sim.gd, effect_system.gd, wheel_sim.gd and stop_sim.gd, with the pointers into 5.4, 5.8, 6.1, 6.2, 6.5 and 9.6. All of it was read and run at commit cf5650b, checked out detached because this worktree's own branch held only docs/; the branch is restored, so the probes need a checkout of cf5650b. I ran 22 probes driving the hand as cabin_suite.gd does (two drinks, a sip at the stack cap, the phone while pulled over, in a Snap and at a stop, Focus with Patrol and Tailgater, items at a stop, buying and placing everything a first stop sells) and a 10-round random fuzz with invariants, which found no violation. I also ran six mutant batches against the whole suite. Every number in the 7.4 table matches data and behaviour; the defects are in how the rules meet stops, hits and the hand. Not reported because D-040 decides it explicitly: chewing seeds does not shield the Tailgater's cut-off (+5).

findings.title: A mixtape bought (or picked free) at a stop can never be put in the deck: the radio dial takes the hand
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_buy_tape2.gd: the fuel station of the 9th fuel-station seed offers the mixtape; a TAP buys it (cash 100 -> 75); nine drags from the tray to the `tape` anchor (dead on, and 20 px off in eight directions) all end 'snapped to radio, rested at radio (radio active true, tape active true)', stop_place completes 0 times, and on leaving the cash is 100 again with no tape. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_buy_all.gd: of 28 item-to-slot placements a first stop can sell, only 'mixtape -> tape' fails. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_boss_tape.gd: Telling seed 3 (drivers), the boss stop of act 1 holds out thermos, mixtape, fog_lamps; taking the mixtape as the free pick removes the other two, three drags fail, and 0 services are ever held out. Cause: `radio` (index 3) and `tape` (index 4) share one position (both at pointer (1337, 810)); ItemSim._covered('radio') (item_sim.gd:521) is true only once an item already sits in the tape slot, so during the carry both anchors are active, HandSim._nearest_anchor (hand_sim.gd:342) gives the tie to the first, and _resolve_gesture (drive_sim.gd:1562) never finds hand.at_index among the destinations. T-ITEM-MIXTAPE puts the tape in with give_item; no test buys one. A trial patch in _sync_anchors (while carrying, switch off any anchor that shares its pointer position with a carry destination) made the placement work, and T-STOP-01, T-ITEM-MIXTAPE, T-SYN-BEADS-MUSIC and T-HAND-* still passed; the patch was reverted.
findings.failure_scenario: He buys the Mixtape for 25 at a fuel station and drags it to the deck: it cannot be dropped there, stays 'bought' on the tray and is paid back when he leaves, so the Habit cannot be had in a Telling. At a boss stop, choosing the mixtape as the free pick of three loses the pick and, because the pick never leaves the tray, the stop's service as well.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 7.4: 'Mixtape | `tape` | Music that never drifts: -1 Nerves per second | ... | None | 25'. GDD 9.6: 'TAP an offered item to buy it, then DRAG it to a slot' and 'After each boss the player takes one free item out of 3 and one service of their choice'. GDD 16.2: '`radio` and `tape` | (0.38, 0.02, -0.14)'. D-040: 'With a tape in the slot the `tape` anchor takes the radio's place'.
findings.suggested_fix: While something is carried, let an anchor that shares its place with a carry destination give way (in _sync_anchors, or let ItemSim._covered also be true while the covering anchor is a drag destination). Add to T-ITEM-MIXTAPE a tape bought at a fuel station and placed with _drag, and to T-STOP-01 a boss stop whose free pick is the mixtape.

findings.title: A sip in progress when a crash spills the tea still pays as a full hot sip
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_spill.gd: third gear, the hand holding at cup_a, a truck 50 km/h slower ahead in his lane. Output: 'hit kind 2 at hold tick 51; supply now 0; nerves 80.065', then 'after the hold: supply 0, nerves 68.141, awake true (time left 39.96)' and one ritual_completed tea_sip. The crash empties the glass (ItemSim.on_hit, called from drive_sim.gd:1362) but leaves the HOLD running; when it completes, ItemSim.complete runs on_complete without looking at the ritual's `requires` (supply>0) again: consume_supply does nothing at 0 and `give` pays -12 Nerves and Awake 40 s.
findings.failure_scenario: He lets go to sip, drifts into a slow truck 0.4 s into the HOLD (the tea's own risk) and keeps the button down: the glass is spilled and empty, and 0.2 s later he is calmed by 12 and Awake for 40 s from it.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 7.4, Tea glass, Takes: 'Spills in a crash.' Registry T-ITEM-TEA-GLASS: 'it spills in a crash'.
findings.suggested_fix: When a gesture completes, check the ritual's `requires` again against its owner (in DriveSim._complete_ritual or ItemSim.complete) and drop the completion if they no longer hold; or cancel the gesture in progress as soon as its ritual is no longer offered. Add the case to T-ITEM-TEA-GLASS.

findings.title: A TAP that ends just after the phone has rung out counts as a second use of the phone: +30 Suspicion twice for one call
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_phone_late.gd on a quiet `patrol` leg (act 2, seed 71) with a call ringing while watched. Variant: first TAP: Suspicion 0.00 -> 29.83; a second TAP pressed with 2 ticks of ring left and released 4 ticks later: 'suspicion 34.92 (was 5.25)', the caller is gone and he is not answered. First scenario (no earlier TAP): the same late TAP gives call_resolved answered=false (+4 Nerves), then ritual_completed phone_answer on a silent phone and Suspicion 0 -> 29.83. Cause: complete() sets phone_used when `not dialling()`; after _miss_call -> _hang_up the caller is empty, so dialling() is false again, and nothing checks `requires: ["ringing"]` when the TAP completes. The window is as long as the TAP's press, up to tap_max_time 0.25 s.
findings.failure_scenario: In view of a patrol he taps the ringing phone once (+30) and his next TAP straddles the 5 s deadline: the call is missed (+4 Nerves), pays nothing, and Suspicion rises by another 30, 60 for one call.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 6.5: 'Using the phone; a Snap | +30'. D-042: 'One call is one use of the phone to whoever watches (+30 once, not per TAP)'. GDD 7.4: 'Three TAPs, 1.2 s, within 5 s of the first ring'.
findings.suggested_fix: The same re-check of `requires` at completion as for the spilled tea (a TAP that completes when the phone no longer rings does nothing and announces nothing), and count the use only while a call is open (caller not empty).

findings.title: A Snap at a stop never ends: the hand cannot reach the tray for the rest of the stop
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_snap_stop.gd: fuel station, Nerves 92, a can drunk at the stop: 'nerves 70.00, snap_left 2.000, snap events 1'; 'after 120 s of waiting at the stop: snap_left 2.000; the hand reaches the tray: false'; a TAP on the first offer: 'cash +0.0'; after leaving 'snap_left 1.992' and the 2 s run on the road. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/habits/probe_stop_use.gd shows the same with a slap at 95. findings.failure_scenario: _enter_stop and _end_boss call items.finish_mending() in step 12, after this tick's items.events were drained, and _save_point() then replaces `items` (restore -> _build): the fault_repaired event is thrown away. items.begin_leg() (drive_sim.gd:461) releases the leg's holds in step 12, after _report_effects() ran (line 394), and effects.begin_tick() clears `expired` at the next tick. findings.title: The cigarette's calm runs one tick too long: -10.0033 Nerves over the burn, because the drip's countdown is a 32-bit float tested against zero
findings.evidence: Probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/wf4/probe_drip.gd: light a cigarette at Nerves 60 with nothing else touching his Nerves: the drip changes them in 3,001 ticks (25 s is 3,000) and adds up to -10.00333. T-ITEM-CIGARETTES checks 'having calmed him by 10 in all' within 0.01, which is three ticks of drip. Same output on the tip 88a7899.
findings.failure_scenario: _drips is Array[Vector2] (line 207): rate and seconds left are 32-bit floats. After 3,000 subtractions of 1/120 the rounding leaves a little above zero and `if drip.y <= 0.0` lets one more tick through. Every 'over N seconds' resource entry is affected the same way; which side the rounding falls on depends on the duration.
findings.gdd_reference: GDD 6.1: 'Cigarette | -10 over its burn'; GDD 7.4: '-10 Nerves over the burn'. D-040: 'Timed statuses are counted in whole ticks like every other countdown (the review's rule)'; D-035: countdowns 'end on their last tick instead of one later'.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the seconds left as a 64-bit float (two PackedFloat64Arrays or a small class) and end the drip with the half-tick rule used elsewhere: `if drip_left < dt * 0.5`.
